type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int) | Dot

fn area(s: Shape) -> Int
  intent "مساحت تقریبی شکل (π ≈ 3)"
  ensures out >= 0
  example area(Circle(2)) == 12
  example area(Rect(3, 4)) == 12
  example area(Dot) == 0
do
  match s do
    case Circle(r) =>
      return r * r * 3
    case Rect(w, h) =>
      return w * h
    case Dot =>
      return 0
  end match
end fn

fn describe(s: Shape) -> Text
  example describe(Dot) == "dot"
  example describe(Rect(1, 2)) == "rect 1x2"
do
  match s do
    case Circle(r) =>
      return text.concat("circle ", int.to_text(r))
    case Rect(w, h) =>
      return text.concat(text.concat(text.concat("rect ", int.to_text(w)), "x"), int.to_text(h))
    case Dot =>
      return "dot"
  end match
end fn

fn total_area(shapes: List<Shape>) -> Int
  example total_area([Circle(1), Rect(2, 5), Dot]) == 13
do
  return list.sum(list.map(shapes, area))
end fn

fn first_area(shapes: List<Shape>) -> Option<Int>
  example first_area([]) == none
  example first_area([Dot]) == some(0)
do
  return option.map(list.get(shapes, 0), area)
end fn
